name: smwmusic-live-a-live-playing-with-psychos-x1-style
title: Live A Live - Playing with Psychos (X1 Style)
description:
The battle theme for the near-future chapter from Live a Live, but with a twist!!! Mainly did this one because I wanted to differentiate this one from the rest of the Live A Live ports that have been coming out recently, but also because I always loved this song and how Megaman-ish it sounds haha

Mainly useful for friendlier battles and chases (lel), but could also be used on levels if it's short enough I guess.
